name: tendsto_integral_smul_of_tendsto_average_norm_sub
statement: Type*} {a : ι → Set α} {l : Filter ι} {f : α → E} {c : E} {g : ι → α → ℝ} (K : ℝ) (hf : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ⨍ y in a i, ‖f y - c‖ ∂μ) l (𝓝 0)) (f_int : ∀ᶠ i in l, IntegrableOn f (a i) μ) (hg : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ y, g i y ∂μ) l (𝓝 1)) (g_supp : ∀ᶠ i in l, Function.support (g i) ⊆ a i) (g_bound : ∀ᶠ i in l, ∀ x, |g i x| ≤ K / μ.real (a i)) : Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ y, g i y • f y ∂μ) l (𝓝 c)

have_tree.name: g_int
have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ i in l, Integrable (g i) μ

have_tree.name: I
have_tree.type: ∀ᶠ i in l, ∫ y, g i y • (f y - c) ∂μ + (∫ y, g i y ∂μ) • c = ∫ y, g i y • f y ∂μ

children.name: A
children.type: Function.support (fun y ↦ g i y • f y) ⊆ a i

have_tree.name: L0
have_tree.type: Tendsto (fun i ↦ ∫ y, g i y • (f y - c) ∂μ) l (𝓝 0)

children.body: by congr; ext y; exact h'i y

children.type: ∀ x, x ∉ a i → ‖g i x‖ * ‖(f x - c)‖ = 0

children.body: by rw [← Function.notMem_support]; exact fun h ↦ hx (hi h)
